card.name: Linking words in repeated label phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words inside stock antidepressant label sentences, mainly "or" after linezolid and "a" in "but at a more gradual rate". It also fires on a few punctuation marks such as "<" and "[".

modes.label: "or" after linezolid
modes.description: The word "or" between linezolid and intravenous methylene blue in the MAOI warning.
modes.example: do not start FETZIMA in a patient who is being treated with linezolid<< or>> intravenous methylene blue ( 4

modes.label: "a" in tapering advice
modes.description: The article "a" after "but at" in the dose-decrease sentence.
modes.example: the physician may continue decreasing the dose but at<< a>> more gradual rate. 2.5

modes.label: Symbols in headings
modes.description: A bracket or less-than sign right after a term, in a creatinine clearance cutoff or a cross-reference.
